role: original joint-library population classification and completed-success economic accounting, with bounded failure-stopping equivalence before launch
registration_context: six dynamic components and nine interface tests passed; 24 structurally selected functional trials all failed service. Six numerical hour-origin interruptions repaired and replayed, leaving 12 conservative physical completions and zero successes among the 24 distinct cells; no full library-population result observed
unchanged: all original component profiles, ordered channel mapping, seed, rounding, forecasts and 2022 fit, 219 original windows, notice schedule, initial stock, asset, request denominators, failure event, tolerance and 48-step brackets; retain all earlier negatives

population.functional_reuse: 18 initial dynamic records plus six repaired records; every original outcome remains separately retained

failure_stopping.reason: the current scalar pilot used 30.63 seconds for 102376 physical-minute evaluations. Failed service windows have undefined full cost; executing their remaining week is unnecessary for the fixed any-failure classification
failure_stopping.rule: stop a new population evaluation immediately when an irreversible failure in the retained window_success definition is observed; never predict a positive completion or drop remaining obligations
failure_stopping.preservation: keep original planned-request denominator, executed prefix, first failure and actual call counts; remaining requests are unassessed. Stopped windows have no full cost or asserted full-horizon physical outcome
failure_stopping.safe_complete_windows: execute every successful window for all 10200 minutes and apply exact actual-settlement cash and terminal adjustment
failure_stopping.equivalence_prerequisite: validate against eight saved full executions before any population launch: four April start-zero successful constant pilots, the 0.35/0.75 July start-zero failure under each rule, and the first functional pair April start-zero failure under each rule
failure_stopping.required_agreement: same service success indicator, original denominator and first failure; successful paths retain stocks/flows within 1e-8 MWh and saved April costs within 1e-6 GBP. Failed paths keep null cost. Count earlier-stop request prefixes separately
failure_stopping.launch_if_discrepancy: preserve the discrepancy and block population launch; do not alter the failure event or discard cells

economics.objective: retained V3 exact gross half-hour MID accounting plus final executed interval discharge-value inventory adjustment; outcome-only prices
economics.full_cost_scope: successful complete windows only; retain null full cost for failures, with no conditional completion-set ranking
economics.replay_reason: earlier compact screen summaries saved only aggregate gross flows; prices vary by half-hour, so those summaries cannot identify metered cash. These 580 successful paths need explicit accounting replays; do not infer cash from gross totals
economics.replay_validation: preserve original success and denominator and match final inventory and gross flows within 1e-8 MWh; retain initial/replayed records and stop on a material disagreement
economics.interpretation: population reliability and observed successful costs only; no source objective or unconditional mean costs are defined by this stage

execution_budget.tests_and_components: record any real controller, policy and trajectory calls separately; no repeated unchanged regressions unless a new failure justifies them
execution_budget.execution_order: equivalence prerequisite first; then deterministic original-roster order in resumable candidate batches, with explicit progress and no repeat of saved cells
execution_budget.runtime_basis: current pilot throughput implies roughly 58 serial hours if every cell runs to completion; this is a workload estimate, not a guarantee. Failure stopping reduces work only after the equivalence prerequisite passes
execution_budget.storage: compact JSONL cell summaries, costs and first-failure contexts; retain full hourly/nomination data only for prerequisite cases or a specific discrepancy, no population-wide minute traces, checkpoints or target-array dumps

gate.scope: assess each candidate under each rule on all original windows; at least one actual joint candidate must meet the retained criterion in every sample, and retain unsafe candidates. The three references do not open the joint gate
gate.reported_costs: report comparable common successful window sets explicitly; no cost ranking across different completion sets

decision: after complete classification and accounting, assess the actual reliable joint-library subset before registering any source-archive study. Keep source comparison HOLD; no threshold, library, target, seed or notice retuning
matrix_launch_prerequisite: eight-case stopping equivalence must pass; freeze then retain its actual call ledger before launching the registered population batches
limitations: overlapping development windows, analyst-defined notices/reset inventory and MID proxy, undefined full costs on failed paths; no source effect, historical BM validity, independent confirmation or OR submission-readiness result
